function.name: sports_ranking_get_top_ranked
function.description: Get the current top ranked athlete for a specific sport.

sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

year.description: The year for which the ranking is required.

message.content:
LeBron James is one of the most famous and accomplished basketball players in NBA history. Here are some key facts about him:

**Professional Career:**
- Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio
- Drafted directly out of high school by the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2003
- Has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers, Miami Heat, Los Angeles Lakers, and currently plays for the Los Angeles Lakers
- Widely considered one of the greatest basketball players of all time

**Achievements:**
- 4x NBA Champion (2012, 2013 with Miami Heat; 2016 with Cleveland Cavaliers; 2020 with Los Angeles Lakers)
- 4x NBA MVP (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013)
- 4x NBA Finals MVP
- 3x NBA All-Star Game MVP
- 19x NBA All-Star selection
- Multiple scoring titles and rebounding titles
- Holds numerous NBA records

**Playing Style:**
- Known for his exceptional basketball IQ, versatility, and all-around game
- Can play multiple positions effectively
- Excellent passer and rebounder
- Dominant scorer with a versatile offensive toolkit

**Off-Court Impact:**
- Active philanthropist through the LeBron James Family Foundation
- Founded the I Promise School in Akron, Ohio
- Known for his business ventures and media presence

He continues to be one of the most influential and marketable athletes in the world.
